David R. Clark

About the author

**International Bestselling Author** David R. Clark is a man who has faced some of life’s most daunting challenges and emerged with a deeper faith and a powerful message of hope. A former Alabama Assistant Attorney General, Judge Advocate General, and private attorney, David’s life took an unexpected turn after sustaining debilitating injuries during his service in Iraq, leaving him 100% VA disabled. But instead of giving up, David chose to channel his experiences into something meaningful. With resilience and determination, he pursued further education beyond his undergraduate and law degrees, earning a Master’s in History and a Ph.D. in leadership and biblical studies. David’s journey through hardship has profoundly shaped his writing. He has authored or co-authored a dozen Amazon #1 bestselling books, each resonating with readers across multiple categories. Four of his books are International Bestselling books.
